product_metadata.title: Sun Zero Easton Blackout Energy Efficient Grommet Curtain Panel, 40" x 84", Chocolate Brown
features: Blackout technology blocks out most unwanted light while enhancing privacy
Energy efficient design reduces energy lost through your windows by up to 40%
Thermal properties help keep summer heat and winter chill out of your home
Noise Reduces outside noise by up to 30%. They will help you get a sounder, better, more uninterrupted sleep.
Built-in metal grommets fit curtain rods up to 1.5" in diameter
Panels sold individually. Measure carefully prior to purchase. (Image features 2 panels)
Performance varies by product color; darker the base color the more light blocked
description: Sun Zero Easton Blackout Curtain is perfect for any room in your home. The woven solid design with an easy to hang grommet-top offers a classic style that fits in with any room decor while blocking light and noise for better sleep; help keep your home cooler in the summer and warmer in the winter. Blackout or opaque panels virtually block all light. This valance when paired with panels does not allow any light to come through; a lamp has to be turned on to see inside a room when closed. This panel gives complete privacy. Sold individually. Hang on a rod up to 1.5 inch in diameter. Polyester. Washable. Imported.
